candidate.definition_en: A man of noble rank or high social title; a master or ruler who holds power over others or over land.
candidate.explanation_ar: سيد أو حاكم، أو رجل من طبقة النبلاء يحمل لقباً رفيعاً (لورد).

senses.definition_en: A nobleman or peer of high social or feudal standing.
senses.explanation_ar: رجل من طبقة النبلاء أو الأعيان ذو مكانة اجتماعية أو إقطاعية رفيعة.
examples: The king granted the loyal lord a large estate in the north.

senses.definition_en: A master or person exercising supreme authority or control over land, property, or subordinates.
senses.explanation_ar: سيد أو صاحب سلطة ونفوذ على ممتلكات أو أتباع.
examples: The feudal system relied on the relationship between lord and vassal.
He behaved like the lord of the manor whenever guests visited.
The feudal system relied on the relationship between lord and vassal.
He behaved like the lord of the manor whenever guests visited.
The king granted the loyal lord a large estate in the north.
